SHARED PLATE PACK (pack-smoke-01) — all four variants compose from the SAME three plates:
1. plate-hero.svg — hero-bleed ridge
2. plate-texture.svg — contour texture
3. plate-proof.svg — pace proof chart
Same material, different composition. That is the divergence test.

A · FIELD REPORT — trust-first. Side rail keeps the plan/proof/coach map always visible; split hero states the offer in one line.
TRADEOFF: less cinematic drama; the plate never goes full-bleed.

B · OPEN ROAD — awe-first editorial. Full-bleed hero, five numbered chapters, no nav at all.
TRADEOFF: slowest route to the CTA; readers must scroll the essay to reach the start line.

C · LEDGER — proof-first. No hero; a KPI strip and the actual training log carry the page.
TRADEOFF: can read as a dashboard, not an invitation; weakest first impression for a stranger.

D · COVER ISSUE (WILDCARD) — the studio as a magazine issue. Alien archetype: editorial-magazine. No CTA above the fold, by contract.
TRADEOFF: memorable but off-genre; may read as content, not coaching.
